title: velocyto_to_h5mu
description:
Convert a velocyto loom file to a h5mu file.

If an input h5mu file is also provided, the velocity
h5ad object will get added to that h5mu instead.

input_loom.description: Path to the input loom file.
input_loom.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `input.loom`

input_h5mu.description: If a MuData file is provided, the velocity h5ad object will be added to this file.

modality.description: The name of the modality to operate on.

output.description: Path to the output MuData file.

layer_spliced.description: Output layer for the spliced reads.

layer_unspliced.description: Output layer for the unspliced reads.

layer_ambiguous.description: Output layer for the ambiguous reads.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
